quote: After Frank de Planta’s Monte Cassino tour, I have been left with memories that will last a lifetime: both in terms of what happened in this area and the lovely people I was able to share the experience with. Frank bombards those on the tour with a depth of knowledge and passion which I very much doubt could be surpassed. He then soothes the group with well-chosen hotels and restaurants that must have been researched with the same meticulous detail as the battles themselves. To be part of one of Frank’s tours is like a smorgasbord of emotion. You will experience and hear about sadness, laughter, disbelief, heartache and courage. Nevertheless, you will never regret it and, if you are considering going to Monte Cassino, make certain that you go with Frank de Planta.
name: David Catchpole
